content: On 2026-08-16 the official RubyGems v1 endpoints for lineclear, line-clear, and line_clear each returned HTTP 404 and exact remote gem searches returned no entries. RubyGems guidance says every published gem name must be unique, recommends underscores for multiword modules, and warns against uppercase. The registry availability is only a point-in-time signal; punctuation variants are distinct lookups and therefore create typo or squatting risk rather than providing brand clearance.
